This engaging program presents little ones with familiar objects in the kitchen, playroom, yard and more -- from the living room window to their favorite teddy bear.

Isn't the world exciting?! Learn about things found in nature like flowers, grass, trees, and leaves with real-life footage and narration. Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

As little ones become better acquainted with the world, they grow curious about animals of all kinds, beyond just the family pet. And as their communication skills continue to develop, they enjoy imitating animal sounds as well. Baby Noah Animal Expedition takes your little explorer across the globe to meet animals -- two-by-two -- from the savannah, the rainforest and tropics, the Outback, the ocean and the Polar Regions.

Babies love animals, and now you can bring animals from the seven continents home to your baby. Meet dozens of exotic animals including Asian pandas, Australian kangaroos and Arctic snow monkeys...all filmed in their beautiful, natural habitats. Rhythms and songs inspired by faraway lands have been orchestrated especially for little ears and encourage your baby to sing, dance and play to the world beats. You'll laugh together at the funny puppet shows featuring moms and their baby animals.

Learn all about music and rhythm in the world around us! Discover classical music and learn instrument names through narration and repetition. Inspire sweet dreams with gentle melodies and a comforting bedtime story. Learn about classical music from Beethoven, Bach, and Mozart. Sing and dance along to classic rhythmic songs like The Wheels on the Bus and see real-life images of instruments.

programmes.st: On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring
programmes.d: As little ones become increasingly mobile, their fascination with all things that move intensifies too. On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring exposes babies to the different ways people travel -- on land, by sea, and in the air -- while it presents them with captivating real-world images, funny puppet shows, and beautiful classical music by Beethoven, Haydn, Mozart and Rossini.

From the moment babies are born, they use their developing senses to discover the world. In terms of sight, bold patterns in contrasting colors or black and white are initially preferred. As for sounds, Mother s gentle voice, in any language, is music to baby's ears. Language Nursery: Voices From Many Lands acquaints your baby with the sounds of foreign language by presenting delightful, visually stimulating images accompanied by spoken passages, natural sounds and music.

Newbie Max paddles 600 metres to reach a lone swimmer treading water near shark nets. Lifeguards attend to skate park injuries, and newbie Tyson tests his skate skills with a pro. Lifeguards Jackson and John both attend to a woman struggling in the surf.

On a quest for world domination, Julian Wall (Karl Malden) and his evil cohorts in the Brotherhood of International Government and Order kidnap Dr. Solaris (Richard Eastham). Helm poses as a gangster, seducing Solaris' daughter, Suzie (Ann-Margret), along the way.

Marsha Meredith (Rosalind Russell) has just been offered a position as a federal judge. Much to her dismay, her nomination is challenged on the grounds that her divorce renders her unsuitable for the courtroom. Desperate to win the position, Marsha arranges a fake marriage to Alexander (Gig Young), even though she still has feelings for Peter (Robert Cummings), her ex-husband. Marsha and Alexander -- and Marsha and Peter -- soon find themselves in a series of compromising situations.

Princess Salome (Rita Hayworth) is the daughter of King Herod (Charles Laughton) of Galilee. Cast out after her affair with Caesar's nephew, Salome finds herself back in the kingdom of her father when she falls in love with Claudius (Stewart Granger), the commander of her father's army. Meanwhile, Salome's evil mother, Queen Herodias, is continually being condemned by John the Baptist, and plotting to use Salome as a tool to get the prophet executed.

During World War II, Englishwoman Stella (Sophia Loren) is involved with Capt. Ford (Trevor Howard), who commands a military tugboat. Ford's mission is dangerous because his slow-moving ship is an easy target. Eventually, he is gunned down in action and Capt. Ross (William Holden) replaces him. Before long, Ross also begins a relationship with Stella, but she warns the newcomer that she may be cursed -- captain after captain has come through her door, and each has met the same grim fate at sea.

One morning a troubled Royal Canadian Mountie officer hits the tipping point and snaps killing one of his own. Plus, the son of a Las Vegas judge robs 1.5 million from the Bellagio Casino, dressed in full biker gear. The Biker Bandit's downfall? Pure stupidity.

Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance.

After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain.

Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake  Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

Even though he has a new girlfriend, Andy (Preston Jones) can't stop thinking about his old high school love, Jenna (Julia Levy-Boeken), who dumped him and went on to become a high-profile beer pong model. When he learns Jenna is on tour with a beer pong tournament, he and his friend, Arash (Danny Pudi), decide to go on on a road trip and follow them. After a series of misunderstandings and several encounters with the law, Andy and Arash catch up with Jenna and the tournament.

Ujae continues to be cruel to Seoyeong and that has opened up an opportunity for Seoyeong to get closer with Yeonhui. Seoyeong withdraws her resignation and plans to tell Ujae the truth. But Ujae doesn't turn up and just tortures himself at Seungu's party. Meanwhile Sangu and Migyeong make peace whilst Seongjae and his mother reach an agreement with Gibeom. In the end, Ujae talks to Samjae and is convinced to give Seoyeong another chance and sends her to her brother's wedding unaware.

Ujae continues to discover more secrets about Seoyeong that seems to drive him to the end. Meanwhile, Jiseon shares how she met Seongjae and why she's so attached to him. Meanwhile Hojeong and Sangu return from their honeymoon and get ready to start their new lives as Migyeong gets drunk and tells Seonu something she shouldn't hear.

The truth behind Seongjae is revealed and to help quieten this turmoil, Ujae and Seoyeong put their troubles on hold. Meanwhile Hojeong is happy playing newlyweds and Minseok is enjoying his free life. In the end Jiseon confronts Executive Yun about Seongjae.
Major developments in Seongjae's true identity and the relationship between Seoyeong and Ujae. Hojeong continues to adjust to married life whilst Seongjae gets ready to confess his love for Eunsu.

Seongjae runs away from home because he can't handle the shock and Seoyeong and Ujae team up to get him back. They've put their troubles on hold for now which shows some hope that things might work out. Jiseon files for divorce whilst Minseok makes a successful debut. In the end, Seonu gets one step closer to ruining Seoyeong's life.

Having discovered Seoyeong's secret, Seonu works out a way to get her revenge. Seongjae is still on the streets and Seoyeong tries to cheer up Jiseon whilst Hojeong is living happily as the new bride.

Seongjae's home and things are still heated between Jiseon and Somi. Somi won't give up her right as a mother. Meanwhile things are also continuing to get heated between Lawyers Jeong and Lee... But a coincidental run in between Jiseon and Seonu at the law firm makes everything spiral out of control. Just as Ujae is about to forgive Seoyeong and start again, Seonu drops the bombshell on the family.

Hwon learns from Hong Gyu-tae that Princess Minhwa was involved in the death of the Crown Princess. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, who remains by Hwon's side, is tormented by her inability to offer him any comfort. Having reached a final decision, Hwon goes to confront the Grand Queen Dowager.

On her way to warn Hwon of an impending rebellion, Bogyeong witnesses him sharing a tender moment with Yeonwoo. Driven by jealousy and fear, Bogyeong summons Kwon, the former head shaman of Seongsucheong, and orders her to place a dark curse upon Yeonwoo.

As Hwon heads toward the Royal Ancestral Shrine, he is surrounded by Yoon Daehyeong's private soldiers. Leading the rebel forces, Yangmyung raises his sword against Hwon, while Yoon Daehyeong coldly orders that the king be executed. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, fleeing to a hideout with Hong Gyu-tae, is seized by a deep and ominous premonition.

Raon disguises herself as a man named Samnom and does all kinds of work to earn money, pay off the debts and find her mother. One day, she is kidnapped by the moneylenders, and they sell her to the Office of Eunuch Attendants to get their money back. She happens to work as a eunuch when she is a woman.

To become the official eunuch, the trainees have to pass three exams which are the physical fitness, the written exam and the character test. They will be kicked out of the palace once they fail at least one of them. In order to escape, Raon tries to fail, however, Yeong intentionally helps Raon so that she cannot escape from the palace.

The King personally orders Raon to deliver his response of Consort Park's letter, and it turns out to be a secret letter written with apple vinegar. Meanwhile, Yeong realizes that the King has been doing nothing just to protect his people. In order to share his burden, Yeong suggests the King to command him to take the throne in the interim.

Sonic becomes aggravated that maybe their efforts of fighting for freedom seem pointless. Sonia suggests that they go to the Oracle for advice.
Robotnik has his eyes set upon Queen Aleena's crown jewel, but Sonic, Manic and Sonia plan to retrieve the gem before Robotnik.

When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff "unworthy".

Professor Von Schlemmer (from Too Tall Tails) has created a machine which brings dreams to life. When Robotnik hears about it, he forces the Professor to alter the machine so that nightmares come to life.

Robotnik invents a Brain Evolution Achievement Negatizer, or B.E.A.N., in order to make all of Mobius stupid. But instead of turning Sonic and Tails into dummies, the BEAN device turns them into three year old babies!
Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness.

Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programmes.st: Road Trips - "Gobbler Down in Mississippi | Turkey Popper Recipe

After a few minutes, Madison is able to tag a nice Mississippi gobbler.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Becomes America's Next Top Model
programmes.d: The last three models standing must be on point for the most important commercial and photo shoot yet. The two models that shine at the shoot will remain and compete in a pivotal runway show for the judges.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Won’t Stop Talking
programmes.d: (1/2) 32 young women arrive in LA, only to be whittled down to 13 finalists. (2/2) After the field was narrowed down to 13 finalists, the girls were sent to their first photoshoot with Nigel Barker as their photographer.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Cries All The Time
programmes.d: The girls were greeted at Salon Sessions Studio by Tyra, Jay and Miss J for their dramatic makeovers.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Changes Her Attitude

The girls met with the director of Elite Model Management Cathy Gould and Elite Model Claudia Mason, who taught them all about personal style and how to dress appropriately.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Gets Thrown In The Pool

The girls met with actress Tia Mowry (The Game) who taught them how to portray different characters through voice and movement.

programmes.st: The Girls Who Go Down Under

programmes.st: The Girl Who Picks a Fight

programmes.st: The Girl Who Blames The Taxi Driver

programmes.st: The Girl Who Does Not Want To Dance
programmes.d: The girls met with Aboriginal Elder Uncle Max and his niece Calita, who taught them about the native Australian art of storytelling through dance.

When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Rommie is rebuilt to help evacuate the Seefra system.
A warlord convinces his followers that the approaching destruction of the outer planets is a plot to make it easier to loot their planet.

programmes.st: Chaos and the Stillness of It
programmes.d: Dylan, Rhade, and Beka work together to rescue Trance from Methus-2 and Harper from General Burma.
The crew finally makes it out of the Seefra system, and discover Dylan is the last Paradine; the World Ship wasn't destroyed, and Nietzscheans have begun their plan to destroy Earth.
In the series finale, the final battle to save the New Systems Commonwealth begins.
After being left stranded near a black hole, Capt Dylan Hunt is discovered by a mercenary salvage ship to find he has been frozen in time for 300 years.
Dylan protects the Andromeda from the mercenaries while Beka starts to wonder if they are fighting for the wrong side.
Dylan finds a space station full of kids who believe he is there to bring peace by killing their enemies. He is manipulated into unlocking his weapons locker.
The crew of Andromeda is still learning how to work together as they are attacked by the Restorers.
The Andromeda gets involved in a feud between a Than planet and a Nietzschean colony. Tyr must choose between his clan or his new family aboard the Andromeda.
A slipstream sends the Andromeda back in time to just before the Commonwealth fell. The crew must intervene to preserve history.
Answering a distress call leads the crew to pick up Beka's brother, now a Wayist, and his friend. They are connected to environmentalists trying to prevent space travel.
A black hole allows Dylan to communicate with his former fiancee, 300 years in the past. He can't abandon his mission to reform the Commonwealth, but can he bring her into the future?
Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.

programmes.st: The Pearls That Were His Eyes
programmes.d: Beka learns that her father's former business partner deals in a highly addictive drug called Flash. The rest of the crew holds a "garage sale" to earn money for new ship parts.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: I'm an Alien
programmes.d: While on their way to school, Josuke and Okuyasu find a young man lying unconscious in the middle of what appears to be a crop circle.  When they try to take a closer look, the man suddenly wakes up and starts claiming he’s an alien from outer space.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 1
programmes.d: Rohan is convinced that Josuke is cheating in their game of Cee-lo when all the dice rolls in his opponent’s favor. Feeling insulted, Rohan stabs his own finger and swear he’ll find out how Josuke is cheating in their next round.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 2
programmes.d: Rohan sacrifices himself to save Josuke from a remote-controlled Stand that sucks nutrients out of its victims. Moved by Rohan’s act of bravery, Josuke races through town to find and defeat the Stand’s user before it can kill Rohan.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Cats Love Yoshikage Kira
programmes.d: Shinobu tells her husband, Kosaku, that she saw a stray cat in their basement with a hole in its throat. When Kosaku goes down to take a look, he finds the cat already dead, The next morning, a strange plant sprouts from the spot where the cat was buried.

Yoshihiro Kira spots Kosaku Kawajiri and instantly recognizes that it’s actually his son, Yoshikage. Meanwhile, Josuke, Okuyasu, and Mikitaka find a strange man living in an abandoned electrical tower.

Josuke enters the electrical tower again to save Mikitaka and defeat Toyohiro Kanedaichi. Meanwhile, Rohan receives a visit from a first-class architect named Masazo Kinoto, who’s come to estimate the repair costs to his burnt house.

Rohan finds himself possessed by Masazo Kinoto’s Stand, Cheap Trap, who tells the manga artist to burn the photos he took of the people in Morioh. Meanwhile, Josuke and Yuya encounter the Stand user responsible for Koichi’s disappearance.
Rohan calls over Koichi to help him fight off Cheap Trap, which has attached itself onto Rohan’s back. Unfortunately, Koichi thinks Rohan is pulling a prank on him and leaves.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bites the Dust, Part 1
programmes.d: Kosaku Kawajiri is forced to kill Hayato after the boy threatens to expose him as a killer.  To make matter worse, Kosaku learns from his father, Yoshihiro, that Rohan and the others are coming to investigate the Kawajiri family shortly.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bites the Dust, Part 2
programmes.d: Yoshikage Kira gains a new ability called Bites the Dust, a bomb that automatically kills anyone who tries to discover Kira’s identity through Hayato. Realizing that the only people who could stop Kira are ones with similar powers.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 1
programmes.d: Hayato’s attempt to kill Kira using Stray Cat’s air bullet ends in failure. Kira realizes that letting Hayato repeat the same morning is becoming a risk, so he decides to undo Bites the Dust after he sees through Rohan’s death.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and Hayato hide inside a nearby residence to escape from Deadly Queen and Stray Cat’s attack. But to their horror, Kira is somehow able to close in on them from outside the house.
Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.
Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association, Hellish Blizzard issues an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker.
Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S-class hero Tank-top Master.
Metal Bat guards some VIPs while Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.
Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.
All of Zero’s strength is not enough to kill Rido, and Rido runs away. However, Kaname finds Rido, and Zero arrives soon after.
Cross Academy, consists of Day Class and Night Class sessions. Although the Night Class consists of students that are all beautiful, intelligent elites, they are in fact vampires!
Tomorrow is the annual St. Xocolatl’s Day, when it is customary for the girls at the academy to give chocolates to the boys.
Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive.
Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hand, the power of the Death Note.
While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.
Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.
Light, now known to the world as Kira, tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways.
Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan.
Ibara and the other passengers rejoice after their train has successfully escaped from the Zone.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira finds himself being chased by hordes of undead when a zombie pandemic breaks out.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Down to his last beer, Akira evades zombies to reach the store and runs into a mysterious woman.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira's made his way to Shinjuku to see Kencho, the only friend he's still in touch with.

Office worker Mizuki is tasked with discovering what causes an inpatient to become a ghost at a certain hospital. He meets a dying pregnant woman from the Ghost tribe while investigating, and soon enough he is told: The ghost at the hospital is dead…

The awakened Yasha and Vampire Dracula fight for one prey: the president of a company, the person who commissioned Mizuki to investigate the cause of the ghost inpatient. Due to Mizuki’s disappearance, the president is brought to the brink of bankruptcy.

Mizuki comes back from hell. A singer, Trump Shigei, meets Mizuki and learns about the existence of the ominous Kitaro. One night, Rat Man plants a seed of the vampire tree in Shigei’s body, turning the frightened Shigei into a tree gradually…

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross, Day 2
programmes.d: On the second leg of their road trip through Scotland, Charlie Ross comes face to face with the penguins of Edinburgh Zoo and Christina Trevanion dares to step onto the top of the iconic Forth Rail Bridge.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross, Day 3
programmes.d: Antique experts Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross travel through northeast England on the third leg of their road trip. After his last success at auction, Charlie is feeling flush but can Christina catch him up?

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross, Day 4
programmes.d: Beginning in York, Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross head to auction in Bourne, as Charlie learns of a simple invention that changed British roads forever and Christina hears the story behind the 400-year-old hand of a Catholic Saint.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross, Day 5
programmes.d: Experts Christina Trevanion and Charlie Ross begin the final day of their road trip in Spalding, before heading toward Boston. Christina has been closing in on Charlie's lead but who will win as they go head-to-head at the final auction?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 1
programmes.d: Antiques experts Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper embark upon the first leg of their brand-new road trip. The experts kick off in Penzance and make their way through scenic Cornwall before going head-to-head at an auction in Liskeard.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 2
programmes.d: It's the second leg of the road trip for antiques experts Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper. After a disheartening first auction, Margie has a lot of catching up to do. But will her fortunes change as the expert head for an auction in Exeter?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 3
programmes.d: Antique experts Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper kick off the third leg of their road trip in Chippenham. Margie learns about the beginnings of modern photography and Paul learns the fascinating history of Farleigh Hungerford Castle.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 4
programmes.d: After a very successful auction, antique experts Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper kick off leg four of their road trip in South Wales and make their way across the country for a penultimate auction showdown in Llandeilo.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 5
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper begin the last day of their trip together in Newport, South Wales before heading to Newent. Paul is in the lead, but Margie is snapping at his heels. Who will win as they go head-to-head at the final auction?

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Anita Manning, Day 1
programmes.d: It's the beginning of a new road trip with Thomas Plant and Anita Manning. The experts are touring the country in a yellow Lotus and their first leg sees them start in Hertfordshire and work their way towards an auction in Banbury.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Anita Manning, Day 2
programmes.d: On day two of their trip, Thomas Plant and Anita Manning travel around the southwest of England. Thomas learns about one of the UK's great inventing families, and Anita finds out how a mistake on a map resulted in the naming of America.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Anita Manning, Day 3
programmes.d: Antique experts Thomas Plant and Anita Manning are embarking on the third leg of their road trip. Thomas is leading the charge after his success in the last auction, but can Anita catch him up?

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Anita Manning, Day 4
programmes.d: Beginning in South Somerset, Thomas Plant and Anita Manning head towards auction in Wimborne, Dorset. Anita learns about a prehistoric man at Cheddar Gorge and Thomas hears about one man's pioneering fight to forecast the weather.

programmes.st: Thomas Plant and Anita Manning, Day 5
programmes.d: Antique experts Thomas Plant and Anita Manning begin the final day of their road trip in the seaside town of Brighton. Anita has taken the lead with just one auction to go. Does Thomas have what it takes to claw his was back to victory?

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and James Braxton, Day 1
programmes.d: Old friends become rivals as antique experts Phil Serrell and James Braxton hit the road in a 1955 Austin Healey. The men start their journey in Glasgow and Phil heads off the mainland before the pair meet up again for auction in Edinburgh.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and James Braxton, Day 2

Nicole debates her treatment of Ted while he deals with an unwelcome reality check. Tyrell and Samantha clash, which leaves Martin and Smitty to deal with the fallout. Leslie one-ups the Duprees. Naomi and Jacob help a friend.

In Part One of a Two-Part crossover episode to conclude on Without A Trace, a kidnap victim from New York who went missing six years ago may be the same boy whose death Grissom and the CSI team are investigating in Las Vegas.
A suspect from Sara's past returns, causing her to question her future as a CSI.
Warrick's addiction to pills begins to impact his job when his investigation into the underground mob in Vegas results in him being targeted as the prime suspect in a mob-related murder case.
Hodges has ulterior motives when he stages hypothetical murders in the lab to give his colleagues a chance to play CSI.
Grissom and his team delve into the world of illegal dog fighting to find out who is responsible for the death of a wealthy socialite.
Grissom and his team investigate two murders that take place at the annual bull riding rodeo in Las Vegas.
Grissom and his team battle the flu when they are called upon by DDA Klein to investigate the deaths of several key witnesses for a grand jury case against a dangerous Las Vegas gang.
The disturbing death of a 3-year-old girl has a great impact on Catherine as she searches for clues to her murder.
Brass and Nick get help from an unlikely source, an incarcerated criminal (Method Man), when investigating two murders that take place in the same apartment building.
Grissom and his team discover several victims who have green blood, leading them to the conclusion that their deaths are somehow connected.
Grissom and the CSI team become involved in the world of Hollywood comedy when a diva sitcom star (Sagal) meets an untimely demise while filming her show in Las Vegas.
Warrick is accused of murdering a famous Vegas gangster, and even he is uncertain of his guilt or innocence.

A feverish night in Las Vegas results in one dead male in an alien suit, one more dead male in a bathtub, one dead female with two suspicous men at the scene, and another dead male with a polaroid of yet another dead male.
Heavy rains in Vegas wash up a body in the storm drains. As the team investigates, they find bones in the sewer system that could only be murder.
A young girl is abducted from outside a convenience store, triggering an Amber alert.
A woman is found dead in a hotel suite with symptoms of the ebola virus.
Grissom and Sara investigate the murder of a woman after a swap party where the married couples in the neighborhood meet and switch partners.
Horatio and the CSI team exhaustively search for Horatio’s son after he goes missing during a surprising and deadly prison break.
When a sports legend is murdered, the investigation hits a snag when the lab loses the body.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Bizarre occurrences begin to plague the CSIs as they hunt down a serial killer who struck during a total eclipse of the sun.
When a model is electrocuted on the runway, the case leads Horatio and the CSI team back to Horatio’s son and his nemesis.
When a family vacation turns deadly, the CSIs must find the killer before the survivors take justice into their own hands.
An attempt on Calleigh's life puts both her professional and personal life in jeopardy.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Lifestyles of the rich and famous come under the microscope of Horatio and the CSI team when a wealthy family's nanny turns up dead.
When a rare and illegal machine gun vaporizes three weapons' smugglers, the CSIs must find the killer before the gun causes more deaths.
Horatio's ex, and Kyle's mother, resurfaces in Miami as a billionaire's widow who will do anything at all to get her son back.
While investigating the murder of a woman, the CSIs uncover a meth lab in her apartment and an unscrupulous FBI agent with a secret life of his own.

programmes.st: You May Now Kill the Bride
programmes.d: Horatio and the CSI team investigate a murder at a wedding, the clues eventually lead the CSI team to a local strip club.
Horatio's past comes back to haunt him when Julia has him arrested for murder.  The CSI team must investigate to clear him.
Horatio deals with ghosts from his past, the team races against time to save Calleigh from a group of dangerous kidnappers.
Horatio and the CSI team must act quickly to stop a vigilante who has been on a killing spree, targeting Internet predators.
A body in a sinkhole leads Horatio and the CSI team to a robbery, while investigating they discover the target holds a shocking secret.
When Alexx's son becomes a suspect in a murder, saving him has dire consequences.  Horatio and the CSI team must act to clear him.
When a man is killed due to a fake 911 call, Horatio must face off with a private investigator who is systematically destroying the team.
When three defendants are gunned down on the eve of their trial, Mac is forced to make good on a promise he made to a reluctant witness.
Investigation of a floating crime scene leads the team into the world of SecretU an art-house world of true confessionals.
When two men who share the same name as detective Mac Taylor are killed, detective Taylor rounds up all the other Mac Taylors in New York and tries to figure out who will be the next victim.
The remains of a pregnant 17-year-old are found in the trunk of a crashed car, but the baby is missing. During the investigation, Danny finds out some shocking news about Lindsay.
The CSIs are forced to investigate two crimes at once with a mysterious energy field near The Empire State Building at the center of both.
The CSIs appear to have an open and shut case after a murder suspect is impaled during a police pursuit, but it turns out to only be beginning.
Young brides-to-be fight over a killer dress at the biggest wedding gown sale of the year and one of the shoppers winds up dead.
The CSIs must piece together a human jigsaw puzzle when a beloved wrestling coach's severed body parts are found buried throughout the city.
A Russian tourist is found stabbed to death and the CSIs come face to face with the frightening realities of human trafficking.
When the Mayor's dead body falls from the ceiling at a charity fundraiser, Stella and her date find themselves in the middle of the crime scene.
When a buzzard flying over Manhattan drops a human eyeball from its claw, the race is on to find the body it belongs to.
A lethal pipe bomb blows a Manhattan townhouse and valuable evidence to pieces, forcing the CSIs to get creative in reconstructing evidence.
A former medical examiner is found murdered, a white powder found at the scene provides the CSIs with a major lead in tracking the killer.
When a Native American chief is shot, the CSIs struggle to translate which one of the several foreign suspects may have caused his death.
While investigating the shooting of a man in an empty theater, Stella realizes that the crime scene is oddly familiar and staged.
When a man falls 52 stories to his death, and his body goes missing after it hits the ground, the CSIs must treat this as a missing persons case.
The most exclusive jewelry auction of the year ends abruptly when an appraiser is killed during the event. The investigation takes an emotional turn.

Phoebe and Paige must work quickly before Piper is tricked into giving up all of their powers when The Source taps into her brain, altering her perception of reality and placing her in a mental institution.
Paige brings a baby-robot and gives it to Piper and Leo to see if they can conciliate having a baby of their own and vanquishing demons.
The Charmed Ones must protect the muses from a warlock who is trapping them into a magical ring and using their inspiration to make the Forces of Evil more powerful.
Paige has an unresolved trauma since she blames herself for the death of her parents in a car wreck.

Phoebe is serving on a jury in a murder case, and she is convinced that the defendant is guilty. However, when she touches the murder weapon, she has a premonition of the real killer, who has a Medusa tattooed in his right arm.

Cole proposes again to Phoebe, only now as a normal human, and accepts Paige's proposal to come work for social services, where his zeal to deal with slum lord Alan Yates soon exceeds human boundaries.
When The Seer foresees the demise of The Source by the Halliwell sisters, he decides to break the covenant between good and evil unleashing the ultimate power, the forbidden The Hollow

Phoebe has a strange sensation about Cole, and she casts a spell to know whether she should marry him or not, bringing unexpectedly an innocent Phoebe from her childhood and a bitter Phoebe from the future to help in her decision.

The Seer foresees that the son of Phoebe and Cole will be very powerful, and The Source, who possessed Cole's body, must bring him to the evil side marrying Phoebe in the dark way, i.e., in a cemetery with a dark priest and drinking the bride's blood.
The Seer blends a potion in chocolates to Cole give to Phoebe and conceive a son in the full moon night.

After 60 years of searching, two ghosts who fought with Leo in WWII come after him seeking revenge for old wounds. When they turn this wrath on his loved ones and kill Piper, Phoebe and Paige face the horror of losing another sister.
The Charmed Ones fight a vampire queen who kidnaps Paige and tries to turn her against Piper and Phoebe.

programmes.st: We're Off To See The Wizard
programmes.d: Piper and Paige team up with a magical Wizard to stop the coronation of a new Source, not realizing that the new head of the Underworld is Cole and Phoebe is his Evil Queen-to-be.
Phoebe is irritated with the lack of attention of Cole and destroys five of his demons in a couple of days.
Phoebe's unborn baby begins to show signs of demonic powers as it begins to take control of her body and attack Paige and anyone else who might be a threat to it.
While Phoebe feels Cole trying to contact her, the Angel of Destiny comes to the Halliwell manor and proposes to remove the powers of the sisters as a reward for vanquishing The Source.
Carla hires an Englishwoman to fill Diane's place while she's in Europe.
Carla takes revenge on her despised former high school principal.
In a cliff-hanging season finale, Frasier proposes to Diane while in Europe, wanting to get married the very next day.
Frasier returns to Cheers with news that Diane joined a convent.
Sam and Diane surprise Woody with a visit from his hometown girl.
Diane finds a coat and believes the mysterious owner is the man of her dreams.
Carla's 16-year-old wants to marry his high school sweetheart.
Diane is convinced the crazed actor from her past is out to get her.
Sam tries to cover up the truth when he loses Diane's priceless book.
The guys of Cheers try to lift Carla's spirits when she places a personal ad.
Norm hires a private investigator to find out if Vera is having an affair.
The Cheers gang challenges a rival bar to a bowling tournament.
Cliff learns his estranged father is leading a secret life.

Diane uses Sam as a case study for a paper in her Human Sexuality class, but she paints an unflattering picture of him. Meanwhile, Woody challenges Carla to a sports trivia contest, and Cliff grows a unique squash.
When Woody becomes hooked on football game betting pools, Sam steps in to make him see the error of his ways.
Sam realizes his baseball days are history when no one bids on his jersey.
Diane doesn't trust anyone when she's certain revenge is coming her way.

Diane convinces Sam to go to Frasier with fake depression symptoms so that Frasier can analyze him and get his confidence back as a psychiatrist. But Frasier comes back with a diagnosis that Sam's depressed because he's still in love with Diane.
Cliff invites Diane and Carla to the annual ball and both unexpectedly accept.
Sam flips when Frasier wants to marry the first girl he dates after Lilith.
Norm gets a tip at work that could guarantee his promotion over the competition.
Sam suffers a hernia while trying to prove that he's not getting too old.

programmes.st: Save The Last Dance For Me
programmes.d: Carla turns to Sam as a partner to go up against Nick and Loretta in a dance competition.
Sam and Diane reveal their true feelings for each other while on the verge of death.
Frasier plans a pick-me-up party for Diane, but she thinks it was Sam's idea.
Woody feels replaceable when an entertaining bartender overshadows him.
Sam expresses interest in politics when he falls for a woman running for city council.
Diane quits when she finds out Sam's girlfriend wants her fired.
Diane tries to make Sam's life miserable for pushing her out the door.
It is revealed that it was Diane to whom Sam proposed on the telephone in the last episode.
Sam's date, Vicki, checks out of a country inn to visit her grandmother in the hospital.
Cliff fixes his mother, Esther, up with the wealthy Duncan Fitzgerald.
Frasier appears on a television show for a debate with Dr. Lilith Stern.
Mentors Anne Burrell and Rachael Ray teach the celebs how to cook lobster.
The mentors play a taste-and-describe game with the celebrity recruits.
The celebrities learn how to make classic crepes in Cafe Worst Cooks.

programmes.st: Celebrity: Around the World in a Day
programmes.d: The recruits have to make their own hand-pulled noodles from scratch.
The recruits play Family Food, a game of food trivia and culinary tasks.
The recruits make over-the-top milkshakes topped with decadent sweets.
The celebs face off in an Iron Chef-inspired battle called Tin Foil Chef.
The final recruits cook a restaurant-quality meal for a panel of experts.

programmes.st: Can It Really Be This Bad?
programmes.d: The mentors teach 16 terrible cooks how to make breakfast.
Recruits must fillet and prepare fish in a boot camp turned fish market.
The recruits put down roots in the kitchen and learn how to cook veggies.
Recruits play games to determine flavors for their game day creations.
The recruits learn how to make new dishes from common leftover ingredients.
The recruits learn how to make Valentine's Day sweets for their sweeties.
The boot camp recruits learn the ugly truth about sausage making.
The recruits learn the art of pasta making from experienced Italian nonnas.
The final four recruits compete to represent Anne and Tyler in the finale.
The final two recruits must cook a 3-course, restaurant-quality meal.

programmes.st: Celebrity: Hit Me With Your Best Dish
programmes.d: The new cast of celebrity recruits gets their first Boot Camp challenge.
The celebrities play a fast-paced relay game before making fish and chips.
Both teams face off in multiple rounds of celebrity-driven food games.
The Barnwood Builders work close to home to salvage a barn in Alderson, WV.
In Alabama, the team faces obstacles transforming a ranch house by a lake.
Mark and the crew salvage their first-ever cabin built by Finnish settlers.

programmes.st: Home is Where the Timber-Frame Heart Is
programmes.d: The Builders convert a massive timber-frame barn into a wedding venue.
The team saves a legendary fort dating back to 1775 in Lake Lure, NC.
The team restores a 19th-century gunsmith's cabin for a Tennessee museum.
Mark challenges the guys to build a timber frame using a new notch system.
The team returns to Lake Lure, NC, to rebuild a previously salvaged cabin.
The crew salvages an 1860s log home and its rare, 36-foot logs in Wise, VA.
The Barnwood Builders battle severe weather to save an 1853 Kentucky cabin.
The guys need handwork and hydraulics to take down a West Virginia cabin.
The guys are out to save a unique double pen bank barn from the 1800s.
The Barnwood Builders build a custom log guest home in the Smoky Mountains.
The Barnwood Builders save one of the biggest barns they’ve ever seen.
The Barnwood Builders are building themselves a timber-frame pavilion.
The guys travel to West Alexander, PA to save a classic bank barn.
Mark and the guys create a rustic family gathering place in Franklin, TN.
The guys work on a 19th century cabin they took down in Ripley, WV.
The Barnwood Builders uncover the craftsmanship of an 1840s barn in Maine.
Designer Karen Tillery helps Mark begin to realize his village dreams.
The Barnwood Builders take on one of their toughest takedowns ever.
Mark and the guys save a cabin picked by the youngest member of the crew.
At a big city Catholic school, Father O'Malley and Sister Benedict indulge in friendly rivalry, and succeed in extending the school through the gift of a building.
General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.
Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

Intense, enthralling, and unforgettable, Sunset Boulevard stars Gloria Swanson as Norma Desmond, a faded silent-movie star, and William Holden as Joe Gillis, a down-on-his-luck screenwriter whom she enlists to help her make her triumphant return.

This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.
After marrying a soldier during a wild night on the town, a small-town girl suffers amnesia and can't remember anything about the man she married.
Vivian's pleasure at Arthur's sudden burst of amorous behavior is overcome by panic when it becomes obvious that Arthur is just not himself.

Maude's anger over Mrs. Naugatuck's sudden strange behavior threatens to end their three-year friendship. Maude fires Mrs. Naugatuck, and insists that she leave immediately, until she finds out that she will never see Mrs. Naugatuck again.

Maude is furious when she discovers her wallet is missing after an encounter with a West Indian woman in a New York subway. Her fury turns to rage when the woman suddenly shows up at the Findlay house.
Driven by a severe case of guilt, Maude extends a less than sincere invitation to her trying aunt Tinkie, but can't possibly be prepared for the suffering yet to come.
Maude's liberal beliefs are put to test when she insists that Phillip invite his friend Sam to spend the night, only to be confronted by an unexpected situation.

Alex tells Elaine that her hectic schedule of being a mother, a cabbie and a museum employee is driving her crazy and that she should see a psychiatrist. Elaine decides that a quicker cure would be to spend the night with Alex.
Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programmes.st: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa
programmes.d: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex

The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programmes.st: You’ve Come a Long Way Baby
programmes.d: Much to Oscar's disconfiture, Felix brings home an abandoned baby.
Felix and Oscar turn detectives to learn the source of the huge bankroll flaunted by the kid next door.
Felix tries to reform after his finicky attitude towards food ruins an otherwise pleasant dinner with his ex-wife.

programmes.st: What Does A Naked Lady Say To You
programmes.d: Felix's new romantic interest is not the librarian he thinks she is.
Steve warns Chip to respect others' property.
Mike learns the secret to business in psychology class.
Robbie's class project involves making investments.
Bub's old friend, a baseball team manager, comes to town to accept an award.
Rob recalls his and Laura's attempts to get married when Ritchie brings up the subject.
Rob is puzzled when he discovers Laura's secret bank account.
Rob doesn't know what he's in for when he invites Buddy's charming, pool hustling brother over for a friendly game of billiards.

programmes.st: My Husband Is Not a Drunk
programmes.d: A hypnotist visits a Petrie dinner party where Rob accidentally picks up a post-hypnotic suggestion.
The dog suddenly becomes a second-class citizen at the Shady Rest hotel when Steve and Betty Jo and Betty Jo move in.
Uncle Joe, caught with too many fish in his possessions by Game Warden Orrin Pike, is threatened with a jail sentence.
Betty Jo finds herself growing jealous of the attention Steve is giving to their daughter, so the pair go on a second honeymoon together, at their old cottage.

programmes.st: One of Our Chickens is Missing
programmes.d: Two rough motorcyclists,suspected of poaching, are too many and too tough for Game Warren Orrin Pike to capture.
Sparks fly when the three Bradley sisters and Dr. Craig find themself competitors in a beauty contest.
An unknown singer tries to smuggle an adorable Vietnamese orphan into the United States by bringing her to Hooterville.

programmes.st: A Date with Miss Camp Henderson
programmes.d: A bet between sergeants and Sergeant Carter's lies result in Gomer dating Miss Camp Henderson and taking her to Lookout Point.
Both Gomer and Sergeant Carter are conned by an old bum.

Sergeant Carter takes a temporary desk job writing training manuals and considers making it permanent when he sees the platoon does fine without him; so Gomer messes things up to bring the Sergeant back.

Sergeant Carter is in a restaurant with a girl other than his girlfriend when he foils an armed robbery. The Sergeant doesn't want his girlfriend to know he was there with another woman so he pins the credit on Gomer.
Gomer gets his first shot at the obstacle course.
Gomer helps a recruit smuggle his girlfriend into the barracks.
An elderly gentleman "takes from the rich and gives to the poor" to help with fellow senior citizens' medical expenses.
Believing her baby was kidnapped, not stillborn as people claim, a mother embarks on a murderous quest to find the truth.
Mannix thinks his traffic reporter friend saw something that made his killers shoot down his helicopter.
Mannix is skeptical of a little girl's claims of overhearing a murder plot, until it becomes clear someone wants her dead.
Mannix becomes less skeptical when a woman predicts from a dream he will be killed, when other things she described start happening to him.
A woman hires Mannix because she was followed from Hong Kong by a man, after her husband seemingly committed suicide over a shady deal over there.
J.R. investigates the disappearance of three women in a five week time period, and then gets involved with a psychic to help him when it looks like she might be his best chance of solving the case.

Betty goes undercover at a rehabilitation center for substance abuse addicts to investigate a suspicious death and discovers a sinister scheme where they administer dangerous drugs that keep patients coming back.

A beautiful disco dancer is harassed by numerous men from the disco where she dance's and her life is threatened. When her roommate is murdered she believes it was meant to be her and she asks J.R. to investigate.
A high tech security team asks Barnaby to help them with a case in which a wealthy businessman narrowly escaped a kidnapping attempt.

programmes.st: Blood Money Is Hard to Wash
programmes.d: Mainland gangster Victor Jovanko terrorizes football team owner to sell club for money laundering operation for mainland syndicate.
McGarrett investigates mystery of sunken Soviet sub, becomes suspicious when computer storage unit needed to unlock secrets appears.

programmes.st: Requiem for a Saddle Bronc Rider
programmes.d: Why have the bodies of a young man, painted bright orange, and a young woman been dumped into the sea? Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett has no knowledge, yet, of that incident, but his search for a missing rodeo cowboy is related.
The runaway teenager daughter of legendary Los Angeles police detective Babe Mandell is framed for murder, then frantically   vanishes   into a religious cult to escape pursuers.

A grim team of crooks who are out to steal M-16 rifles from military armories and sell them to inter-national terrorists, plus a pair of hang-gliding pranksters add up to double trouble for McGarrett.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Vic Glendon, the ex-husband of Sparta councilperson Harriet DeLong, has been charged with murder and is facing a death sentence. Harriet's teenage son, Eugene, is most affected by the trial and the conflict he feels towards his criminal father.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: A double murder at a local roadhouse is the focus of the Sparta police, and a young witness is reluctant to come forward. Now that they are parents, Althea Tibbs worries about Virgil’s safety on the police force and asks him to consider law school.
When a dying contract killer confesses he was once paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter goes in pursuit of the true murderer.
Hunter and McCall's investigation of a teenager's death leads them to a contemporary Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes for him.
Amanda cruises into cyberspace during a spell of boredom and randomly enters the website "Welcome to Joanne's living room" for mindless entertainment.

Steve joins his troubled partner, Reggie Ackroyd, in a rehab facility for stressed-out cops. Reggie seems delusional and keeps blaming a murderer he caught for abducting his wife and daughter, and Steve encourages him.

It's a busy day for the homicide unit and Community General when three murders take place. Further investigation reveals that none of the suspects knew their victims, and they are all terminal patients at Community General.

Walker and Alex go white water rafting and camping trip. In the morning, a rafter is found dead. The group continues rafting to the nearest station for help. Meanwhile, there is a prison outbreak and convicts are heading towards the rapids.
Walker realizes the rafting guide is one of the escaped convicts who killed the real organizer. Walker must find a way to capture the convict and save the others on the rafting trip.
A local gang is destroying businesses and starting turf wars. They threaten a boy in Walker's karate class and force him to join the gang. The Rangers must save the boy and stop the turf wars.

A former boyfriend of Alex is in trouble when a prison is released from jail, waiting for a new trial. The crime boss is killing the witnesses that put him in prison in the first place. Walker must save the witness so he can testify again.
Richard Kimble is a crewman on a yacht chartered by an embezzler's wife under police surveillance.
Kimble is hired by a construction boss to replace his female assistant, who bitterly resents the intrusion.
Eileen Heckert repeats a guest starring role -- she originated as a nun who aids Kimble in tracking the one-armed man.
MacGyver heists an ancient Chinese artifact as a ransom for a woman he once loved, only to learn she's double-crossed him.
When former mobster Jimmy "The Eraser's" new identity is exposed, MacGyver is forced into action to save Jimmy's daughter and grandson.
While hiking through remote wilderness, MacGyver uncovers an elaborate scheme to siphon oil from a pipeline when he comes to the aid of a young girl, terrorized by the legendary Sasquatch.

Jesse and Susan are on their way to Mount Carmel for a romantic getaway weekend but detour to a fishing town when their car breaks down. They grab a bite at the local diner when Susan sees a man she used to know.

When resident Paul Brewer is killed, it's the second murder in a month at the exclusive gated community, Hillview Estates. With no leads on the killer, Steve goes undercover as Dr. Steve Brewer, a community resident.
Robbie and a friend decide to start raising pigs for profit.
Mike's Air Reserve squadron falls apart during his absence.
Mr. Wilson tells Dennis he isn't feeling well just to get Dennis to leave him alone, but Dennis of course spreads the word and leads everyone to believe that Mr. Wilson is very sick.
Mr. Wilson gives Dennis a book called Secrets Of The Indian Rain Dance, and he and his friends decide to give it a try.

programmes.st: The Creature With The Big Feet
programmes.d: Mr. Wilson sees large footprints in his yard caused by Dennis' new novelty shoes and thinks they may be from a monster that has been reported in the newspaper.
Dennis decides to help along a potential romance between an older friend of his and a new girl in town.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Jim The Farmer
programmes.d: Feeling stressed out from all the pressure at work, Jim decides to give up his job, move to the country and become a farmer.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Father Of The Year
programmes.d: The Springfield newspaper is sponsoring a Father of the Year contest. The Anderson children set out to write the winning essay, but can't find the words to describe the best father in the world.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Mink Coat
programmes.d: Money is tight and Jim lectures the family on fiscal responsibility. The very next day he is presented with an extraordinary opportunity to buy Margaret a mink coat for less than half the regular price, and he grabs it.
Margaret wages a campaign to get her cousin's boyfriend to propose. Though Louise is hesitant to trap Tom, Margaret is sure she knows what to do and takes over.
Bill, Cissy, and Mr. French continue to search for Buffy and Jody in Spain. Meanwhile, the twins are being cared for at a schoolhouse run by nuns.
The twins are finally found and reunited with their family.
Buffy likes a boy at school. She starts purposely failing her classes so she does not seem smarter than him. The school thinks Buffy is able to skip a grade but she does not want to skip.
Jody has been exchanging letters with a pen-pal from Bolivia. Finally, the boy gets a chance to visit Jody in New York. When he arrives, everyone is more interested in him than Jody.
The rival school's quarterback suddenly takes an interest in Marcia the week of the football game., and Mike is Jealous when Carol's high school sweetheart comes for a visit.
Jan thinks she' has no talent after not being chosen for a ballet recital, so the family tries to make her feel better and help her find a skill.
Mike takes the entire family on a trip to King's Island amusement park, where he is to submit plans to a client, but the a mix-up causes the blueprints to go missing at the park.
A series of misunderstandings lead the Bradys to believe that Alice and Sam are up to much more than just bowling on their upcoming Saturday night date.

Jan makes a bunch of promises to be elected "Most Popular Girl" in her class, but backs out of them after she wins the election. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol try to make plans for their second honeymoon.
A couple Mike and Carol know adopt a young boy, but the boy soon misses his two best friends--one African-American, one Asian-American. As a result, the couple decides to adopt all three boys.

Edith and Archie rush Stephanie to the hospital for an emergency appendectomy on the eve of her 10th birthday. Luckily, the surgery goes perfectly, so they celebrate both Stephanie's birthday and the success of her operation.
The Bunkers head out to California for Christmas to find out that Mike and Gloria are having marital problems.
Separation is Archie's reaction when he discovers that Gloria has been unfaithful to her husband. For the first time in nine years, he turns his back on his daughter and sides with Michael.
When Edith invites butcher Klemmer and his new sweetheart, a Russian who is the spitting image of Edith, she notices that Klemmer might have the hots for Edith and not for her.
Archie and Edith are shocked when they discover that Stephanie has been stealing some of her favorite teacher's (and the Bunkers') belongings.
After Stephanie comes back from Sunday School, Rev. Chong visits Edith to tell her that even though she is welcome anytime at Sunday School, Stephanie is Jewish. Edith accepts it, unlike Archie.
Barney Hefner is suicidal when Blanche finally deserts him, until Archie fixes him up with an overweight but wealthy widow.

When an ill woman tells Edith to let her die with dignity at the SunShine Home, the woman's family are furious after her death. The manager fires Edith for her selfishness, even though Edith honoured the woman's wish.
Iola declares her independence from her mother … and moves in with Mama.  Now, the family unites with a single purpose: to get Iola out of the house.
Naomi and Vint decide to adopt a child, but they are rejected as parents by the adoption agency. When all finally seems lost, Naomi discovers that she is pregnant.
Naomi and Vint sell Mama's homemade tonic, and it goes incredibly well until Bubba's team loses its swim meet. When the tonic is analyzed, everyone discovers it's 35% alcohol!
Mama and Naomi suspect Vint of more than a working relationship with his new trainee, who happens to be a beautiful blonde.
With Naomi happily pregnant, Iola starts to think she should be married too. She finds a boyfriend, but the relationship doesn't last through their first dinner with Mama.

programmes.t: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach

programmes.t: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programmes.d: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all the great composer's sixteen string quartets.

Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programmes.d: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.
Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.
Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programmes.st: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.
One family faces two unsolved murders of their loved ones. It takes thirteen years for detectives to uncover the one missing clue that can lead them to the killer: the hidden crime scene.

In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.
The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.
A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.
While babysitting for a family of well-behaved but sheltered children, Daria enlists Jane to help her broaden the kids' horizons.
Quinn feels so pressured to get plastic surgery after another Fashion Club member gets a nose job that she pulls Daria out of class to go to a consultation with her.
On a spring day in 2011, Abbi and Ilana meet for the first time.
Abbi's brief return to Soulstice gets interesting when she's given the training opportunity that she's always dreamed of. Meanwhile, Ilana gets a new job at a restaurant.
Sarah campaigns for fake mayoral candidate May Kadoody, and Steve asks Brian to consider marriage.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program A Good Van Is Hard to Find
programmes.d: Brian and Steve fight over laundry responsibilities, and Sarah realizes that vans make people creepy.

Cesar revisits some of his toughest cases and sees how being on the show changed not only the dogs, but the lives of the owners.
